name: Bao
review: Thanks, My family had a great vacation.

name: Beth
review: Perfect airbnb. Oanh was so helpful, the accommodation & location are exactly as described. There were added extras (projector, speaker, yoga mats & fresh eggs on arrival!) which made it feel immediately like home. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay again. Thank you so much.

name: 佳欢
review: The house is beautiful, and the surroundings are exceptionally quiet. You can hear birds and insects. The yard is full of flowers and plants, and the host has a pair of kittens and puppies. The environment is very therapeutic.The Host is also very welcoming. He helped us rent a motorbike, which gave us a convenient means of transportation when we couldn't find a motorbike taxi anywhere in the city during May Day. It was very touching! (PS: If you have requirements for sleeping in the dark or don't want to climb a slope to get in and out, you should still consider it a bit.)

name: Echo
review: This place is really nice like a little paradise. The dog friend is quite friendly and stay with you together like a protector. The garden is beautiful, full of flowers and fruits. The room is nice and clean. Just one thing, it’s not easy to approach if you are with big suitcases. There’s a way up and it’s not easy to cary your luggage.

name: D E Mi
review: I fell in love with this house at first sight!The room is transparent, the sunlight passes through the leaves and shines into the room, it's just the life I imagined in Da Lat!The garden is full of hydrangeas, and there are many plants, most importantly!Gow is really the best puppy I've ever seen!Every day, no matter morning or evening, they will pick us up and drop us off at the room, very safe, very principled little dog!Although the road to the room is indeed a bit difficult, I think it is really worth it to stay in such a room!

name: Natalie
review: Very quiet and idyllic place to stay. Beautiful views of the countryside and the best, sweetest dog you could imagine.

name: Leonie
review: We loved our stay! It was such a beautiful house, a little hidden away but that’s exactly what you want. Very calm and a beautiful lush garden!

name: Siriporn
review: Nice houses

name: Knock
review:
What a splendid home that felt like some sort of Ghibli dream. I feel so fortunate to be able to travel to Da Lat and experience this place, the lovable Gao (adorable dog), and a tranquility that reminds me why I travel. 
Air BNBs now often feel cold and business like. This is the reason why I continue to use the app. The home away from home. Hospitality and care by the team. 
I truly wish I could stay longer.

name: Diana
review: An amazing villa where we celebrated New Year’s Eve! Everything was wonderful. The only small note is that getting directly to the villa by motorbike can be a bit tricky, but aside from that, everything was absolutely perfect.

name: Jamie
review: Loved our stay! Beautiful garden and comfortable home.

name: Sietje
review: Perfect spot if you want to have a secluded stay, but still be very close to the city centre. We loved the presence of a beamer! Also the beds upstairs are very nice :) We ordered food with Grab, which went relatively easy! Would definitely recommend!

name: Omar
review: Very distinctive house, suitable for leisure and play, the Host and the housekeeper are all very nice!

name: Quang Anh
review: The place really left me feeling very happy for my 35th birthday with my friends. Thank you so much

name: Kate
review: The house is an ideal choice if you are looking for absolute tranquility, a large well-kept garden and you are comfortable with pets (the family has a very friendly dog). Furniture, kitchen utensils and laundry area are at a level that meets the needs of use, and the house is a bit humid (possibly due to the rainy season in Dalat), but the fresh air, the birds singing in the early morning and the full privacy of the house will make up for it all, be patient to feel the excitement of the house in the early morning. If you choose this place, enjoy the outdoor space to host meals at home.  An experience I found very interesting!

name: Beatrice
review: Hospitality, peaceful place

name: Huynh Thanh
review: Absolutely loved our stay! The house is beautifully designed, and the garden is truly stunning, a perfect place to relax. The host was super friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. We really, really enjoyed our time here. It showed us a very different, refreshing side of Da Lat than we’ve ever known. Highly recommended!

name: Long
review:
Third time staying at Ươm after several busy months.
The garden was handled amazingly. Very impressive transformation within the spans of 6 months. Shout out to Uom’s butler/gardener for that.
The homestay still maintains its stellar surroundings very well. I had 2 nights in a beautiful house within a beautiful garden. Didn’t even bother going out since there are so many vegetables growing inside, and miss Thao (the butler) helped me buy rice as well as protein.
Most of my time there, I spent recharging, breathing the fresh air and brewing tea or coffee depending on my mood, and every second worth it.
 So yes, just like a few months ago, I still recommend you to book Uom. Because you’re worthy of a nice retreat too!!!

name: Hien
review: It just 👍

name: A Friend's Home
review: We had amazing experience at Uom Reatreat. It's a very Da Lat vibe house, the original Da Lat that we haven't seen for a long time, so different from the hustle Da Lat center, and you just only need to drive 10min to Da Lat market. We love the glass walls, the curtains. We could even use fresh veggie in the garden, they have some interesting fruits. Their pets are friendly and lovely, they make us feel like home. They have everything you need for a retreat stay. It takes only few minutes to find a market to buy some foods, so you could enjoy the house from morning till night. Oanh shown us how to go to the pine hill near by, we had a nice walk under the pine trees. Overall, we love our stay and the vibe of the house, we're so glad that we've found this unique experience. Highly recommend this house to who want to find some peace. Definitely will come back to watch the grown up hydrangea, also visit Gau and Bo.

name: Lam
review: I loved our stay at this Da Lat villa! It was the blend of comfort and charm, with a beautiful garden. The location was not so easy to find as normal hotel, and we had everything we needed for a relaxing getaway.

name: Cheng Wee
review: The place is beautifully designed, environment is tranquil and the host is extremely helpful. It is exactly what the name suggested, a garden retreat. we stayed almost a week and it was the best experience we had in Dalat. The host has an extremely well-behaved dog and a cat living on the compound, adding so much to our overall experience. We are already planning a return to Uom Retreat Garden in the near future.

name: Thắng
review:
Super recommend!
The home was truly worth our walk.
The house is very large, beautiful and clean along with a convenient location to go to famous tourist attractions in the city. Especially we were extremely impressed with the huge garden that made us feel like we were in the fresh and cool country.
We enjoyed most of the time  in the house, really didn't want to go out when staying here.
The host was very proactive and easy to get in touch with when we needed information.
Thank you, we had very precious and relaxing time.

name: Trang
review: Such a beautiful hidden gem amidst a dynamic Da Lat center. A private garden with lots of fruits, unique leafs and flowers  and a wooden house following zen style is suitable for family to have relaxing gateaway. We had a cozy bonding and fire camp at night which was truly memorable. Host is always proactive to help us when needed and reccommend beautiful local places to visit. Definitely will come back again when come to Da Lat.

name: Eja
review:
The Host's house is beautiful and perfect for a vacation.The Host was also very nice, sent us a small gift before we left, and agreed to store our luggage temporarily.
There are a lot of mosquitoes in the house, because it is close to the garden and jungle, there are often small geckos, ants and mosquitoes, although the host has explained and reminded before booking.Prepare enough mosquito and insect repellent sprays before check-in.
The dog is very well-behaved and cute, and seems to have a bit of a problem with the cat haha.But the two animal friends around the house give a sense of comfort.
I highly recommend the Host's house.

name: Michelle
review: The place is nice and clean, we got everything we need in the house. Their team is helpful and their pets are supper friendly to children. Definitely be back. We recommend the place to who want to find a peaceful and unique experience in Da Lat.

name: Ngan
review:
Nice house, quiet space, nice view. You guys are very supportive.
House has a dog friend named Bear and cat friend named Cow is super cute. I wake up early in the morning to practice Yoga, the Bear stands beside you. Cows are around in the house and love to lie next to guests in the sofa.
The road to the house is a bit steep, so it is suitable for a group of young people to find a place to relax, should consider if there are many items or have elderly people and young children with them

name: Long
review:
Spent 1 day & 1 night here. Worth every penny due to its excellent location and beautiful surroundings. I didn't expect this private experience can be found right in the city.
A quick ride to Dalat Market only takes 10 mins, and there were some excellent restaurants nearby as well.
I spent this morning walking to a teahouse nearby and it was amazing too.
The cliff could be a bit difficult to climb if you're not a strong driver, but a part from that, i wholeheartedly love my experience here. Too bad that I only spent 1 night as trial here cause I totally would love to stay more.
10/10, will come back very soon to visit Gau and Bo!

name: Ryan
review: place is awesome , had a cute cat and dog but the place is a little inaccessible especially for those with elderly and young kids , luckily I came with friends and had a really good time there :)

name: Tùng
review: The place is cozy although we were just a four-people family but it was a great experience as everything was really good. The host - Ms Oanh is super friendly and very helpful. The dog always sticked to us and even slept with me the last night. Thank you for everything

name: Tram
review:
a gem in the middle of the city .
we had a great vacation
will be back the nearest day
thank you host
send a bear and bo visit
very nice place highly recommend to you guys.

name: El
review: Beautiful house, very peaceful and giving the Da Lat vibe. We’re really enjoying our 5days stay. Highly recommend this house the get a unique experience at the Da Lat city center.

name: 예원
review:
The host's accurate and timely response was very convenient, and the place was so beautiful. There is a puppy and a cat host. They were very cute and lovely, and the scent was nice. The process of finding the location was a little complicated, but it was convenient that the hosts were always there to help.
I was also impressed by the well-maintained garden. It was the best place to stay in a vibe contrary to a comfortable hotel in the city. It is especially recommended for writers and digital nomads who write while enjoying nature.

name: Khoa
review:
I have to say very happy, from the housekeeper to the owner, everyone is enthusiastic. Space for 6-7 great people always. 
Recommended!!! 10/10

name: Yến Nhi
review: The house is extremely suitable for those who want to chill chill to relax. Fully furnished in the home. There is a large yard growing vegetables and flowers outside. There are also two dogs and cats who are extremely cute and wrapped. Heating fire can be used if desired. Your host and manager are extremely friendly and enthusiastic. I feel like walking up a slope is worth it. Definitely will come back next time with a longer stay ❤️

name: Lam
review: Beautiful peaceful quite place.

name: Thư
review: beautiful house and amenities are very suitable for groups of 8-10 people, there are gentle and friendly dogs and cats, me and my group of friends are very happy 💗💗
